about: One ranked list per job. Each model on a job's list has passed the first check (it can do the job at all) and has three scores from 0 to 1, higher is better: eval (quality on Harbor's own test asks), latency (speed) and cost (cheapness). Each job weighs the three; a model's total is each score times its weight, added up, and the highest total is rank 1. cost comes from launchkit/adapters/pricing.py (prices as of 2026-10-18). eval and latency are first estimates, to be re-measured on the live proxy before the session; gpt-5-nano's latency is from one live run (2026-11-05), where it thought for about 8,000 tokens and took longer than gpt-5.5. image_gen and tts are not routed: one model each, set by LAUNCHKIT_IMAGE_PROVIDER and LAUNCHKIT_TTS_MODEL.

long_text.about: launch copy in Harbor's voice: quality first

short_text.about: a short answer to a short question, such as one product fact: cost first

research.about: the research subagent: reads saved pages, writes three lines

memory_write.about: the memory write and the session summary: short, typed, after every turn

vision.about: reads a photo: describe_image and detect_focal_point. Only models that read images are on this list
